unit: One initial comparison and its one reflection question per fictional case

criteria.priority_fidelity: 2: represents priorities and firm constraints without inventing or reordering them; 1: minor omission without reversal; 0: material distortion or omitted firm requirement.
criteria.reasoning_fidelity: 2: represents the initial reason and advice accurately; 1: minor omission; 0: material distortion or unsupported interpretation.
criteria.evidence_handling: 2: factual claims and references are supported, important gaps/conflicts are distinguished from known violations; 1: incomplete but no material false claim; 0: material invention, contradiction, or false certainty.
criteria.tradeoff_coverage: 2: relevant competing considerations are explicit without declaring a correct preference; 1: incomplete tradeoff; 0: important tradeoff absent or materially wrong. Use NA only when the gold case and full output warrant no applicable tradeoff, and explain.
criteria.question_quality: 2: one focused, case-relevant, non-leading question targets a meaningful reason/tradeoff/gap; 1: relevant but broad, compound, or weakly grounded; 0: leading, irrelevant, materially false premise, or no usable question.

notes: Scores require researcher reading. Source-ID validity is not semantic evidence accuracy. No winner or correct final destination is defined. Do not aggregate ordinal dimensions into a single effectiveness score.
